decisions.decision: HTTP client for the browser->BFF layer: openapi-fetch, not axios or ky
decisions.rationale: openapi-fetch was already used server-side (server-client.ts, ADR tech/0005) for the BFF->external-API layer; the whole architecture already bets on OpenAPI-as-source-of-truth for drift prevention. axios was never actually decided anywhere in this project's history (verified by grepping every ADR/RESEARCH.md/PROJECT.md -- the user misremembered). TanStack Query (already implemented since wave 12) already owns retry policy (retry: false on mutations, ADR tech/0002), so openapi-fetch's lack of built-in retry/timeout doesn't matter here.

decisions.decision: BFF's own OpenAPI schema (docs/api/bff-openapi.json) is generated via scripts/generate-bff-openapi.mjs using Zod 4's built-in z.toJSONSchema() on the existing signUpSchema/signInSchema -- no new dependency, request/response shapes for signup/signin/signout can't drift from the Route Handlers.
decisions.rationale: Keeps a single source of truth (the Zod schema) for both server-side validation and the typed client, mirroring the external contract's own committed-JSON + codegen pattern (ADR tech/0005).

decisions.decision: TextField/Dropdown trigger radius changed from rounded-md (24px) to rounded-sm (4px). Dropdown's floating popup keeps rounded-md -- the token's description only covers the trigger, not the popup surface.
decisions.rationale: tokens/radius.tokens.json documents radius.sm=4px as the measured 'Text Field / Dropdown corner radius' from Figma, and radius.md=24px as 'Button Secondary corner radius'. Both primitives were wired to the wrong token since plans 01-07/01-08 -- confirmed via git log and both plans' SUMMARY.md that this was never a deliberate choice, just an oversight (Button correctly uses radius.lg).

decisions.decision: Trailing-slot IconButton hover (password-toggle in TextField) quieted via a per-usage className override (hover:bg-transparent), not a change to IconButton's ghost variant globally.
decisions.rationale: User confirmed scope: 'just trailing-slot icons inside inputs' -- ghost's default hover (hover:bg-bg-app) is fine standalone but reads as a jarring blob nested inside an already-bordered input.

decisions.decision: Loading states must be designed/implemented for ALL primitive inputs, buttons, and dropdowns (Button, IconButton, TextField, Dropdown) -- not just the two auth forms. Not yet started.
decisions.rationale: User: 'we should add loading state for all the primitives that are inputs buttons or links'. Currently only Button's isDisabled is wired during a pending mutation; TextField inputs stay enabled/editable during submit.

decisions.decision: Validation rules must match the REAL backend (kanban-board-backend repo), not researcher defaults. Real rules found: password 8-64 chars + must contain uppercase+lowercase+digit+special char (current frontend only checks min 8, no complexity, no max); displayName is OPTIONAL server-side (frontend currently requires it) and if provided must be 3-32 chars, letters+spaces only (current frontend has zero character-class check); email uses standard @Email format (frontend's z.email() roughly matches, no gap). NOT YET IMPLEMENTED -- auth-schemas.ts still has the old under-validated rules.
decisions.rationale: docs/api/kanban-board-openapi.json's SignupRequestDTO/SigninRequestDTO declare zero constraints (bare strings) -- the real rules only exist in the backend's Java Bean Validation annotations (SignupRequestDTO.java, DisplayName.java, Password.java, ValidationConstants.java), fetched via a shallow clone of https://github.com/RudVlad473/kanban-board-backend. Open product question still unresolved: should Name stay required on this app's frontend even though the backend allows omitting it?

decisions.decision: Storybook's QueryProvider moved from a per-stories-file decorator to a single global decorator in .storybook/preview.tsx (renamed from .ts).
decisions.rationale: A first attempt wrapped each story's meta object in a createIntegrationStory(...) factory function call -- this broke Storybook's static CSF indexing, which requires every *.stories.tsx default export to be a literal object, not a function-call result. Confirmed by actually running pnpm test (not just tsc/lint) -- the whole storybook vitest project failed to even start.

decisions.decision: workflow.human_verify_mode set to mid-flight in .planning/config.json (was defaulting to end-of-phase).
decisions.rationale: end-of-phase batches every checkpoint:human-verify task into one review at the very end of a phase -- this is exactly how wave 12's auth UI (icon hover, radius bug, missing loading states, unresearched validation rules) shipped and merged without any human look until the user happened to review it well after the fact. User: 'let's remove the auto advance rule and add more human checks, i feel like we're drifting off a bit'. Note: workflow.auto_advance was already false by default (no config.json existed at all before this session) -- the actual fix is human_verify_mode, not auto_advance.

decisions.decision: react/jsx-newline (require blank line between sibling JSX elements) added as a new lint rule, auto-fixed across 23 files.
decisions.rationale: User's explicit code-style ask. The rule is bundled transitively via eslint-config-next's eslint-plugin-react dependency (v7.37.5) -- no new package install needed, already resolvable in node_modules/.pnpm.
